ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black/grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central-medial portion of both lobes, surrounded by low-intensity (black) boundaries. High-density dark mottling and discrete spots are scattered throughout the white patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth extending into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by varying pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) that are most pronounced near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep towards the outer, upward-pointing fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated heavily at the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) primarily visible on the high-intensity central regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical linear scar on the right lobe and significant barnacle encrustation on the fluke extremities causing structural irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark spotting/speckling within the white ventral pigmentation, particularly dense near the lower medial area.
